describe.character: Juno, a 15-year-old girl: tan skin, short choppy teal hair with one long side lock hanging in front of her right ear, a small scar through her left eyebrow, round brass flight goggles pushed up on her forehead, chunky headphones resting round her neck, an orange cropped flight jacket with a high stand-up collar worn open over a navy shirt, the jacket sleeves pushed up to the elbows, three plain geometric patches on the jacket (a circle, a square and a triangle in flat colours, no emblems, no text), dark-grey baggy cargo trousers with a cream stripe down the outside of each leg and a cargo pocket on each thigh, red-and-white high-top trainers with no logo, brown fingerless gloves

parts.head: her head with all her hair and the goggles on the forehead; the head only, cut cleanly under the jaw with NO neck and NO shoulders
parts.neck: her bare neck only: a plain tan-skin cylinder with nothing on it
parts.torso: her trunk from the collar down to the jacket hem: the orange flight jacket and the near half of its stand-up collar, with what this view shows of the navy shirt and the headphones resting on the collar; NO head, NO neck (the neck opening is empty: magenta shows through it) and NO arms: where an arm would join, draw only the jacket's round armhole seam
parts.collar_back: the far half of the stand-up collar: the inside of the orange collar as it shows behind her neck, in the darker shade tone, with the dark headphone band lying along it
parts.pelvis: her hips only: the top of the dark-grey cargo trousers with the belt, from the waist down to a plain rounded bottom at the crotch; no legs
parts.uarm: an upper arm only: the orange jacket sleeve from the shoulder down to the pushed-up cuff at the elbow; no forearm, no hand
parts.farm: a forearm and hand only: bare tan forearm from the elbow, plain rounded end at the elbow, brown fingerless glove, hand relaxed with fingers lightly curled
parts.thigh: an UPPER leg only, hip to knee, in the dark-grey cargo trousers: plain rounded ends at the hip and at the knee, NO cuff, NO ankle; the cargo pocket and the cream stripe are on the outer face of the leg only
parts.shin: a LOWER leg only, knee to ankle, in the dark-grey cargo trousers: plain rounded end at the knee, gathered cuff at the ankle, no shoe; the cream stripe is on the outer face of the leg only
parts.shoe: one red-and-white high-top trainer with white laces and a white sole, no logo, no marks, no leg in it
parts.bent: one whole leg sharply bent at the knee, drawn as a single piece from the hip to the ankle cuff in the dark-grey cargo trousers, with folds at the knee; no shoe, no foot
